caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular bench with a cushioned seat. The cushion is dark in color, likely black or deep brown, with a slight sheen, and it forms the top surface of the bench. The bench frame underneath the seat appears to be made of wood and is reddish-brown. The bench has six legs, each turned with vertical grooves and tapering toward the ends, all matching in color and style to the frame. The background is plain with an off-white or beige color and some brown stains, particularly noticeable towards the bottom and lower-left corner. The drawing includes a signature in the bottom right corner that reads "Frank Umbden" in green ink or paint.
title: Window Seat
